name: SaaS MSA baseline
description: Playbook de cláusulas esperadas en un contrato marco de SaaS desde la posición del cliente.

clauses.title: Term and renewal
must_have: initial term|subscription term|term of this agreement

risk_flags.note: Renovación perpetua sin salida clara
Periodos de renovación largos (3 o más años)

clauses.if_missing: Sin plazo ni renovación definidos: el contrato puede quedar abierto o renovarse sin control
clauses.suggestion: The initial term is twelve (12) months. The agreement renews for successive one-year terms unless either party gives sixty (60) days' notice of non-renewal.

clauses.title: Services and subscription grant
must_have: right to access and use|access to and use|subscription to|grants customer|grants to customer

risk_flags.note: El proveedor puede modificar o descontinuar el servicio unilateralmente

clauses.if_missing: No se define qué servicio se contrata ni quién puede usarlo
clauses.suggestion: Provider grants Customer a non-exclusive right to access and use the Services during the Term for its Authorized Users, as described in each Order Form.

clauses.title: Fees and payment terms

risk_flags.note: Cambio de precios sin aviso ni tope
Tarifas no reembolsables

clauses.if_missing: Sin condiciones de pago: riesgo de disputas de facturación y cobros arbitrarios
clauses.suggestion: Customer pays undisputed invoices within thirty (30) days of receipt. Fees are fixed for the Term and may be increased only on renewal with ninety (90) days' written notice.

clauses.title: Service levels and availability

risk_flags.note: Los créditos de servicio son el único remedio

clauses.if_missing: Sin compromiso de disponibilidad medible ni compensación por caídas
clauses.suggestion: Provider shall maintain monthly Availability of at least 99.9% and issue Service Credits for any shortfall.

clauses.title: Data protection and processing
must_have: documented instructions|written instructions|data processing agreement|data processing addendum|dpa
applicable data protection law*|gdpr|ccpa|privacy laws|data protection legislation

risk_flags.note: El proveedor puede usar datos del cliente para fines propios

clauses.if_missing: Sin reglas de tratamiento de datos personales: incumplimiento regulatorio probable
clauses.suggestion: Provider processes Personal Data only on Customer's documented instructions and in accordance with the Data Processing Addendum and applicable data protection laws.

clauses.title: Security incident notification
must_have: security incident*|data breach*|breach of security|personal data breach

risk_flags.note: Notificación sin plazo fijo en horas o días

clauses.if_missing: Sin obligación de avisar incidentes de seguridad: el cliente puede enterarse tarde o nunca
clauses.suggestion: Provider shall notify Customer of any Security Incident without undue delay and in any event within seventy-two (72) hours of becoming aware.

clauses.title: Information security measures
must_have: security program|security measures|security controls|technical and organizational measures|safeguards

risk_flags.note: El proveedor se desliga de fallos de seguridad

clauses.if_missing: Sin controles de seguridad exigibles al proveedor
clauses.suggestion: Provider maintains a written security program with encryption of Customer Data in transit and at rest, role-based access controls and multi-factor authentication.

clauses.title: Confidentiality

risk_flags.note: La confidencialidad termina junto con el contrato

clauses.if_missing: Sin deber de confidencialidad: información comercial expuesta
clauses.suggestion: Each party shall hold the other's Confidential Information in confidence, use it only to perform this Agreement, and protect it for five (5) years after termination.

clauses.title: Intellectual property and customer content

risk_flags.note: Licencia perpetua e irrevocable sobre contenido del cliente

clauses.if_missing: Sin reparto de propiedad intelectual: riesgo sobre datos y entregables del cliente
clauses.suggestion: Customer retains all rights in Customer Data; Provider retains all rights in the Services and grants Customer a license to use them as provided here.

clauses.title: Warranties and disclaimers
keywords: compl* with applicable laws|compliance with laws

risk_flags.note: Descargo total de garantías

clauses.if_missing: Sin garantías de desempeño del servicio
clauses.suggestion: Provider warrants that the Services will perform materially in accordance with the Documentation and will re-perform or refund fees if they do not.

clauses.title: Indemnification

risk_flags.note: Indemnización amplia a cargo solo del cliente
Indemnización sin límite

clauses.if_missing: Sin indemnidad por reclamos de terceros (PI, datos): el cliente absorbe el riesgo
clauses.suggestion: Provider shall defend and indemnify Customer against third-party claims alleging that the Services infringe or misappropriate intellectual property rights.

clauses.title: Limitation of liability
must_have: aggregate liability|total liability|maximum liability|total cumulative liability|cumulative liability|liability shall not exceed

risk_flags.note: Lenguaje de responsabilidad ilimitada
El proveedor excluye toda responsabilidad
Tope solo a favor del proveedor

clauses.if_missing: Sin tope de responsabilidad: exposición económica efectivamente ilimitada
clauses.suggestion: Each party's total aggregate liability is limited to the fees paid or payable in the twelve (12) months before the claim; neither party is liable for indirect or consequential damages, except for fraud, gross negligence or data breach.

clauses.title: Termination rights

risk_flags.note: Terminación sin aviso previo
Sin reembolso al terminar

clauses.if_missing: Sin derechos de terminación: el cliente queda atado al contrato sin salida ante incumplimiento
clauses.suggestion: Either party may terminate for material breach not cured within thirty (30) days of notice. Customer may terminate for convenience on sixty (60) days' notice with a refund of prepaid unused fees.

clauses.title: Data return and deletion

risk_flags.note: El proveedor conserva datos del cliente indefinidamente

clauses.if_missing: Sin devolución ni borrado de datos al terminar: riesgo de lock-in y retención indebida
clauses.suggestion: Within thirty (30) days after termination Provider shall return Customer Data in a machine-readable format and then delete it, certifying deletion on request.

clauses.title: Subprocessors and subcontractors

risk_flags.note: Subcontratación sin aviso ni consentimiento

clauses.if_missing: Sin control sobre terceros que acceden a los datos
clauses.suggestion: Provider shall give thirty (30) days' notice of new Subprocessors, bind them to equivalent obligations, and remain liable for their performance.

clauses.title: Audit and compliance reporting
clauses.if_missing: Sin derecho de verificación del cumplimiento del proveedor
clauses.suggestion: Provider shall provide its current SOC 2 Type II report annually and permit a Customer audit on reasonable notice once per year.

clauses.title: Governing law
must_have: governed by|governing law|construed in accordance with
clauses.if_missing: Sin ley aplicable: incertidumbre sobre el régimen que rige el contrato
clauses.suggestion: This Agreement is governed by the laws of the Republic of Peru, without regard to conflict-of-laws rules.

clauses.title: Dispute resolution and venue
clauses.if_missing: Sin mecanismo ni foro para resolver disputas
clauses.suggestion: Disputes are escalated to senior executives for thirty (30) days, then submitted to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of Lima.

clauses.title: Assignment and change of control

risk_flags.note: El proveedor puede ceder el contrato sin consentimiento

clauses.if_missing: Sin reglas de cesión: el contrato puede pasar a un tercero sin control del cliente
clauses.suggestion: Neither party may assign this Agreement without the other's prior written consent, except to a successor in a merger or sale of substantially all assets on notice.

clauses.title: Force majeure
clauses.if_missing: Sin cláusula de fuerza mayor: reglas de excusa de incumplimiento indefinidas
clauses.suggestion: Neither party is liable for delay caused by events beyond its reasonable control; if the event lasts more than thirty (30) days either party may terminate.

clauses.title: Insurance
must_have: commercial general liability|cyber|errors and omissions|professional liability|coverage
clauses.if_missing: Sin seguros exigidos al proveedor: la responsabilidad podría no estar respaldada
clauses.suggestion: Provider shall maintain cyber liability insurance of at least $5,000,000 per claim and provide certificates on request.
